# Evidence
- Problem class: go-test-ci-env-pollution-scrub

- Solved: 2026-11-03T08:27:37.116Z
- Verification: solution produced by pi in sandbox; see signatures.json

signatures.description: Go tests fail only in CI (or under env pollution) because the CI job exports DATABASE_URL/DB_HOST/DB_PORT for its database service while the tests target a local SQLite install; the product deliberately prefers DATABASE_URL and refuses SQLite-only commands when those vars are set (errors like 'DATABASE_URL/DB_HOST/DB_PORT suggest a PostgreSQL backend; unset them (or use SQLITE_DB_PATH)'). Fix class: test hermeticity, not product weakening — save each var with os.LookupEnv, clear via os.Unsetenv/t.Setenv, restore with t.Cleanup (repo precedent commit 90281816 for AWS_PROFILE). Symptoms include CLI tests failing with 'Tree is empty' (connected to the live CI DB instead of the intended SQLite path) and 'reset-password applies to SQLite installs only'. Verified fix 2026-11-02 <project>-memory e938ece3: tests pass clean AND under exported DATABASE_URL/DB_HOST/DB_PORT, full suite green.
